intro: The Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem is a consecrated ritual implement crafted by Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. It is imbued with ancestral magic to purify the corrupted waters of the Thunderhorn Water Well.

p: Across the rolling plains of Mulgore, the lifeblood of the earth is being fouled by unseen corruption. The ancestral wells dug by the tauren tribes provide vital nourishment to the herds and hunting grounds, but foul agents have tainted the water. Entrusted by the elder Mull Thunderhorn, adventurers carry this prepared totem north of Bloodhoof Village to drive out the pollution settling over the Thunderhorn clan's sacred spring. Through ritual invocation, the totem calms the disturbed spirits of the water and cleanses the ancestral site.
